items.title: John Heard interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: There’s no math, there’s no Hindemith, and none of that crap.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, that’s what I do every time I get on the bandstand, man, yeah, that’s it. That’s my concept. The dance and the magic. There’s nothing else. There’s no math, there’s no Hindemith, and none of that crap. It’s all about dance and magic, a smile.

You know Aaron Copland was asked to judge a contest of twentieth century music one day. And they asked him they said, “What do you think of most of the scores that come in from the competition?” He says, “Very little of it sings or dances.” I think that’s what you’re trying to say. It’s gotta sing, it’s got to dance.
